name: personal-ai-foundation
description: A local-first foundation for a private, proactive personal AI system.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n WEB,API,WORKER -c cyan,magenta,yellow "pnpm dev:web" "pnpm dev:api" "pnpm dev:worker"
scripts.build: pnpm typecheck && pnpm build:web && pnpm build:server && pnpm build:worker
scripts.build:server: tsup src/server/main.ts --format esm --platform node --target node24 --out-dir dist/server --clean --sourcemap
scripts.build:worker: tsup src/worker/main.ts --format esm --platform node --target node24 --out-dir dist/worker --clean --sourcemap
scripts.verify: pnpm lint && pnpm format:check && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
